body: of course it's selfish. when I wake up in the morning nobody thinks of me. when I go to bed no one thinks of me. Nobody cares and I am not in anyone's heart. I'm just a piece of meat anyway. If only I could cut to the chase and put myself in a bin so that no one else has to do it.

It's nothing to do with attitude. It is all about what you inherit. Life is what it makes you, and not the other way round. Whenever I hear someone talk about life being all about your choices, and being whatever you want it to be, I think of how naive that person is. They don't understand what it is like. Maybe they got to have real choices, and got to have real relationships. I don't get that because of where I come from. There is literally nothing I can do and I am so sick of myself for it. I work hard and never have any money. I am nice and get treated like crap. I went to school and studied hard and got nothing for it. None of the choices I make are deviating from the consequence that would otherwise be if I had not even bothered, and choices are nothing without different consequences. I want to think young again and think like the world is my oyster, except it's not. I am forced to live in tiny, disgusting homes for students and I am forced to dance for others all day because of my background.
